data.one_liner: Auto-instrument Flutter apps with Dynatrace OneAgent for Android and iOS RUM.
data.what_it_does: The Dynatrace Flutter plugin integrates Dynatrace OneAgent into your Android and iOS apps. It automatically captures native and Flutter user actions, views, network requests, and crashes, while providing manual APIs for extended tracking.
use_when: You need real user monitoring (RUM) and performance tracking through Dynatrace.
You want to automatically track crashes and errors across Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are using a different application performance monitoring (APM) platform like Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry.
Your target platforms do not include Android or iOS.
strengths: Automatic instrumentation of native and Flutter layers.
Comprehensive crash reporting and web request monitoring.
Supports modern routing solutions like go_router.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration files (dynatrace.config.yaml) and native setup scripts.
Stricter requirements on minimum Android and iOS SDK versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding dynatrace.config.yaml to the project root, running the plugin script, and configuring Android/iOS project settings.
